name: Southwestern Black Bean Spaghetti Squash with Cheddar & Cilantro (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 500°F and place rack in the center position. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium spaghetti squash
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim each spaghetti squash, then halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp neutral vegetable oil
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the bell pepper. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
neutral vegetable oil
4 tsp chili powder
1 tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are softened, add beans and tomato sauce to the skillet, then stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the skillet and stir to combine the beans.

Remove squash from the oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand.) Divide between containers, top with beans and cheese, then set aside to cool completely, about 20 minutes.
When the squash and beans are cool, cover and refrigerate until ready to eat. Heat in an oven or microwave and enjoy!
